figureAlts.figure10.gif: (f) Suppose we performed the simulation and plotted a histogram of simulated_stats. The histogram is shown below. The histogram displays the distribution of absolute differences with the x-axis labeled as Absolute Differences ranging from 0 to 10, and the y-axis labeled as Percent per unit ranging from 0 to 40. The bars show a higher concentration of values between 0 and 2, with a peak around 1, and a few values extending up to 4. Is our observed statistic from (c) consistent with the model we simulated under?
